scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
恭喜。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Ah...
The pinnacle
of craftsmanship.
That's the work of
a MasterSmith.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
啊...技藝的巔峰。
那便是神工匠的造詣。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Once you're the
the best of the best,
you begin forging with
the goal of discovering
new and better ways of
crafting...
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
成為頂尖工匠後，每一次鍛造，都是為了探索更新、更好的工藝...

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
The time has come!
Our world needs brave,
hard-working adventurers
like you...
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
時機已到！
這個世界需要你這樣勇敢、勤勉的冒險者...

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Would you like to
become a MasterSmith?
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
你想成為神工匠嗎？

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
準備好了，隨時回來吧。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
你還有可以學習的技能。
請用完剩餘的技能點，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Congratulations!
As a MasterSmith,
I hope you will forge
a path towards a brighter
future for Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
恭喜！
願你身為神工匠，為米德加爾特開闢通往光明未來的道路。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向勇士們致敬！
